issuer.summary: Ethena has a public team, institutional counterparties, recurring attestations, broad third-party monitoring and a demonstrated response to the October 2025 stress event. Issuer risk is tempered by concentrated ENA governance and a mismatch between the voters who allocate protocol revenue and USDe holders who bear reserve risk.
issuer.summary_source: Ethena disclosures and attestations; Snapshot proposal and vote records; October 11 producer measurements.
facts: The ENA fee-switch schedule superseded the earlier Risk-Committee parameters that prioritized Reserve Fund adequacy.
The ratified schedule begins at $7.5bn supply and is dormant against a measured 14-day average of $4.890bn.
The vote closed with 17.786m votes from 88 voters and no opposition; one account exceeded quorum alone.
USDe holders do not vote in ENA governance.
The live Reserve Fund was $62.078m, or about 1.29% of current supply.
